content: Elihu ni Job e a huinaw a oun
Job ni amahoima tamikalan a kâti dawkvah, tami kathum touh ni Job pathung awh hoeh toe.
Hottelah Barakel e capa Elihu, Buz tami Ram catoun Elihu teh pueng hoi a lungkhuek. Cathut hlak amahoima tamikalan a kâti dawkvah, Job koe a lungkhuek.
Job e a hui kathum touh koehai a lungkhuek. Bangkongtetpawiteh, Job hah na payon atipouh eiteh, bout pathung nahane panuek awh hoeh.
Ahnimouh teh, ama hlak vah kacuehnawn lah ao. Elihu ni Job koevah lawk dei hanelah meng a ring.
Elihu ni hetnaw kathum touh e pahni dawk hoi pathung nahan awm hoeh tie hah a panue torei teh, a lung puenghoi a khuek.
Hottelah, Barakel e capa Elihu, Buz tami ni hettelah a pathung. Kai teh kum kanaw teh, nangmouh teh na kumcue poung awh toe. Hatdawkvah, na taki awh teh, ka pouknae hai ka dei ngam hoeh.

content.text: Kum ni dei naseh, kum moikapap ni
lungangnae cangkhai naseh ka ti.
Hateiteh, tami e thung kaawm e muitha,
Athakasaipounge kâha hah
panuethainae kapoekung lah ao.
Tamikalannaw ni hoe lungangnae awm hoeh
kum kacuenaw ni lannae hoe panuethainae awm hoeh.
Hatdawkvah, na thai pouh awh haw,
kai ni hai ka pouknae ka pâpho han.
Khenhaw! na lawknaw hah ka thai teh,
dei hanelah ao telah na pouk lahun nah
na panuesaknae hah ka panue toe.
Kahawicalah na thai pouh haw
lawk ka pathung thai e
Job e a lung pan ka cai sak e, nangmouh thung dawk
buet touh hai na awm awh hoeh maw.
Lungangnae ka hmu toe, tami nahoeh niteh,
Cathut ni ama teh a tâ han na tet awh payon vaih.
A lawknaw ni rep na tâdue hoeh
nangmae lawk patetlah ahni teh bout ka pathung mahoeh.
A lung a pout awh teh, pathung awh hoeh toe,
lawkkamuem ao awh toe.
Lawk a dei awh hoeh toung dawkvah,
ka ring rah, bangkongtetpawiteh,
pathung toung laipalah duem a kangdue awh.
Kai ni hai kama hane ka pathung van han,
ka pouknae teh ka pâpho van han.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, lawk hoi ka kawi teh,
ka thung e muitha ni dei hoeh laipalah,
na awm sak thai hoeh.
Ka thung lae hah misurtui tâconae
kâko kaawm hoeh e patetlah ao.
Misurtui um katha patetlah kâbawng hane coungkacoe ao toe.
Ka kâha a tâco thai nahanelah, lawk ka dei han,
Ka pahni roeroe ka ang vaiteh ka pathung han.
Apipi nakunghai, kapeknae kamnue sak hoeh nahanlah
tami bangpatet hai ka oup hoeh nahanlah ka ratoum.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, tami oupnae hah ka thoum hoeh,
telah nahoeh pawiteh, kasakkung ni
palang na lat payon vaih.
